# scepman_root_certificate (Resource)

Resource to trigger the initial creation of the root certificate for SCEPman.

This resource has no configurable attributes and cannot be modified. Deletion is a no-op.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `der_base64` (String) Root certificate in DER format (base64 encoded).
- `expires_at` (String) Timestamp of the expiration of the certificate.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update of the certificate.
- `pem` (String) Root certificate in PEM format.
- `status_message` (String) Status message of the root certificate creation request.
